name: plusplus
description: Cheaper Claude Code sessions: read and edit by stable line IDs, a model router that sends each task and agent to the cheapest model trusted with it, and a per-project spec and decision tracker

codegraph.title: Code graph download
codegraph.description: ask: offer to download CodeGraph on first run; off: never download or prompt (for managed machines)

codegraphMirror.title: CodeGraph mirror URL
codegraphMirror.description: Base URL to download releases from instead of GitHub, e.g. an internal artifact mirror

router.title: Model router
router.description: on: send each task to the cheapest model and effort trusted with it, never above the session's own; shadow: decide and report, change nothing; off

routerFloor.title: Router floor
routerFloor.description: The cheapest model the router may use

routerLog.title: Router log file
routerLog.description: A file the router writes its decisions to as JSON, for benchmarks; empty for none

specs.title: Specs and decisions
specs.description: auto: where a project has a store (/spec init), agents read its records and may propose new ones; read: agents read and never add; off: no tracker

shellEdits.title: Edits by shell script
shellEdits.description: A Bash command that rewrites a file by script (sed -i, a python one-liner, a redirect onto a file). warn: let it run and tell the model to use edit; enforce: refuse it; off

routerGrader.title: Router grader
routerGrader.description: What grades a task's complexity: haiku (the session's own small model), or jev (TypeSafe's System One API; needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the environment and sends each task's text to TypeSafe)

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: The glyphs the panes, toasts and status line draw with. auto: Unicode, or plain ASCII where the terminal's locale is not UTF-8; unicode; ascii
